app_store.name: Tracemap
app_store.subtitle: Map an app before rebuilding
app_store.promotional_text: Turn public docs into a screen list, flows and data model.
app_store.description:
Tracemap maps an app from public sources.

It lists screens, user flows, components and a likely data model, then plans the stack and schema.

It uses public pages and your own account only.
